authoring_constraints.baseline_focus: constant-velocity planar motion and relative motion
authoring_constraints.closest_approach: small labelled enrichment using table/algebra/completing square only

intrinsic_badges.subtopic: Observer, frame, axes, origin and common clock
intrinsic_badges.reason: One core idea plus conventions; errors are mainly naming/notation rather than multi-step inference.

intrinsic_badges.subtopic: Path, distance, displacement and average quantities
intrinsic_badges.reason: Requires distinguishing path from endpoint change and connecting two average quantities.

intrinsic_badges.subtopic: Coordinates, components and reconstructing a vector visually
intrinsic_badges.reason: Requires translating coordinates to signed component changes and reconstructing magnitude visually; multiple representations interact.

intrinsic_badges.subtopic: Constant motion in two coordinates; tables and graphs
intrinsic_badges.reason: Requires coordinating x and y tables/graphs through one clock, but constant velocity keeps algebra modest.

intrinsic_badges.subtopic: One-dimensional relative motion, units and signs
intrinsic_badges.reason: Requires subtraction order, signs and unit reconciliation, with common intuitive reversals.

intrinsic_badges.subtopic: Relative velocity in two dimensions and observer reversal
intrinsic_badges.reason: Requires component-wise subtraction plus observer reversal and relative-position ordering; multiple representations interact.

intrinsic_badges.subtopic: Meeting requires the same position at the same time
intrinsic_badges.reason: Requires two simultaneous coordinate constraints and rejection of path-intersection-only reasoning.

intrinsic_badges.subtopic: Boat/current and rain/observer model transfer; ambiguity
intrinsic_badges.reason: Requires frame-chain transfer, across/along decomposition and ambiguity diagnosis across unfamiliar contexts.

research_sources.supports: Standard Grade 9 Motion scope: straight-line motion, graphs, distance/displacement, speed/velocity, elementary circular motion; does not itself establish full 2D relative-motion applications.
Optional Advanced Chapter 2 introduces frame of reference, motion as relative, scalars/vectors, graphical vector addition and asks graphical vector subtraction.
Coordinate-system setup, displacement as final minus initial position, average velocity in multiple dimensions, independence of perpendicular components; used to inform B02–B04 explanations/visuals.
Named reference frames and relative position/velocity vector equations in one and two dimensions; used to inform B05–B08 explanations and subtraction diagrams.
Time-axis convention and slope-as-average-velocity for straight position-time graph segments; used for B04 graph decisions.
Official SI symbols m for metre and s for second; supports unit discipline in B05 and all calculations.
